journal_lines: Hollow in the rock, purple-lined. Geode.
Amethyst cluster. Chimed when I worked it.
Crystal lining in the geode. Careful work.
Purple light from inside the stone. Good find.
The geode hollow was large enough to stand in.
Amethyst clusters still growing in the dark.
The sound of the crystal formation was almost musical.
Purple-lit cave. No other source of light needed.
Took only what was fully grown. Left the rest.
The tones varied from deep violet to pale pink. Took the densest.
Geode wall to wall with crystals at different stages.
Smelled mineral and sweet. The interior confirmed it.
A geode cracked clean open by old fault movement. Perfect access.
Three points of the crystal intact. Extracted without fracture.
The outer stone dull grey, the inside a world of its own.
Sat in the geode a moment. Just looking. Then worked.
